text: The secret is having the chip.  Luckily I had the chip from my old GE filter.  This saved the day.  Without the chip the filter will not work.  Waterdrop has a square imprint exactly where to place the chip from your old filter onto this new generic filter.  Mine was the old style GE filter which had a peel off label with the chip in it.  Dont buy this filter if you dont have a chip!!!
